//: `models` is PURE model configuration: how to reach a model and what it can natively do.
Nothing about how a role USES the model lives here — one entry per real model, so the same
model backing three roles is one entry, not three.
`roles` is where usage lives: which model, which prompt/completion contract, and the role's
A role is reached one of two ways and the fields say which: `mcp` grants it TOOLS it calls
itself, `agents` grants it OTHER roles to delegate to as `<role>__ask`. There is no privileged
coordinator — `orchestrator` is simply the role the CLI runs at the top by default.
`dispatchable: true` marks a role another role may name in its `agents` list.
`reranker` names the model memomcp uses to re-rank recall(rank=true) results;
it is not a chat role, so the agent's LLM provider registry skips it.
Change a model assignment at runtime in the REPL with `/model <role>=<model-id>`.
`fsreadonly`/`excelreadonly` are inspection-only mounts of the same servers: give them to a role
whose read-only contract should be ENFORCED (mutating tools simply not mounted) rather than trusted.

qwen-coder.description: Strong 30B coding model with native Ollama tool calling. NOTE: ~18 GB — overflows a 16 GB GPU and crashes llama-server at CUDA init; use qwen-coder-14b until more VRAM is available.

qwen-coder-14b.description: Coder model that fits in 16 GB VRAM (~9 GB); replaces qwen3-coder:30b which overflows the GPU.

deepseek-r1.description: Reasoning-focused model. Planning depth over tool reliability; <think> blocks are stripped before handoff.

llama-fast.description: Small, quick model for summarization and lightweight follow-ups.

claude-haiku-4-5.description: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 (cloud). Fast and reliable. Output $5. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.description: Google most cost-efficient model, optimized for high-volume agentic tasks, translation, and simple data processing. Output $1.50. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.description: Google smallest and most cost effective model, built for at scale usage. Output $0.40. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

orchestrator.description: Default top-level role: full workspace tools, and read-only agents for context it would rather delegate.

workflow-orchestrator.description: Orchestrator variant for headless workflow runs; mounts turnresult so the turn settles on a structured verdict.

summarizer.description: Compacts the conversation prefix once it grows past summarizeAtMessages.

evaluator.description: Terminal judge: reads the transcript and returns PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE.

dispatch.description: Independently verify the turn's work against the original request; returns a structured PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE verdict.

reason.default: evaluator returned no parseable verdict; defaulting to pass

filesagent.description: Read-only workspace file lookups on behalf of a coordinator.

dispatch.description: Ask the FILES sub-agent about the workspace files. It reads (never writes) and reports what it found.

summary.default: the files agent returned no parseable answer

excelagent.description: Read-only workbook lookups on behalf of a coordinator.

dispatch.description: Ask the EXCEL sub-agent about workbooks in the workspace. It reads (never writes) and reports what it found.

summary.default: the excel agent returned no parseable answer
